name: Data Hoarders
summary: Jemma Quikswitch needs her lost punch cards found in the snow outside Gnomeregan. The exiled gnome in Ironforge copied her family's archives onto cards during the flight from the city. Now several are missing, along with records of submarine designs and family recipes.

sections.title: A Scramble in the Snow
sections.body: When troggs invaded Gnomeregan and radiation struck, thousands of gnomes fled with what they could carry. Jemma Quikswitch had copied generations of family knowledge onto punch cards. A damaged satchel spilled several cards into the snow around the fallen city. Without them, the surviving records read as gibberish, and her family's knowledge is at risk of being lost.

sections.title: Equations and Chili
sections.body: The Quikswitch archives range from arcanotechnical field equations to submarine hull blueprints from the Second War. They also hold Grandma Quikswitch's secret chili recipe. For the refugees in Ironforge, household comforts matter as much as engineering marvels.

faq.answer: Jemma Quikswitch is a gnomish refugee who escaped the fall of Gnomeregan and now lives in Ironforge.

faq.q: What data is stored on the lost cards?
faq.answer: The punch cards hold the Quikswitch family's archives, including arcanotechnical equations, submarine hull schematics from the Second War, and Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe.

faq.q: Where did the data cards get lost?
faq.answer: The cards slipped from Jemma's pack as she fled Gnomeregan and lie in the snow just outside the city's gates in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why can't Jemma read the surviving cards without the missing ones?
faq.answer: Jemma says the data is too scrambled to recover without the missing punch cards. The records do not explain how the cards encode or organize that information.

faq.q: What role did gnomes play in the Second War regarding submarines?
faq.answer: During the Second War, gnomes aided the Alliance with advanced engineering. They designed and piloted submersible vessels to counter the Horde's naval forces.

faq.q: Why are gnomish refugees living in Ironforge?
faq.answer: After trogg invaders brought down Gnomeregan and radiation struck, surviving gnomes fled their underground home. King Magni Bronzebeard offered them sanctuary in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can help preserve inventions and family memories from your homeland by recovering the punch cards.
As an engineer, you can see the value in the Second War submarine blueprints and arcanotechnical equations on these cards.
As a cook, you can appreciate Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe among the engineering records.
As an Alliance member, you can help displaced gnomes preserve wartime engineering records and the Alliance knowledge they hold.
